entry.title: A controlled argument about quantum geometry
entry.summary: We show that a constrained geometric construction preserves the relevant boundary symmetry while avoiding an additional dynamical assumption. However, the approximation remains reliable only when the curvature scale is parametrically larger than the microscopic cutoff.

entry.title: Conditional consistency of an effective description
entry.summary: The effective description reproduces the expected infrared response under the stated hierarchy of scales. This agreement does not determine the ultraviolet completion, but it supplies a controlled consistency check.
